name: IGBREIT
recent: IGBREIT 在 2026 年第三季度业绩中，营收和净利均同比大幅增长约 55%，主要来自 Southkey 的贡献。公司宣布每单位 3.51 仙的收入分配，除权日为 11 月 13 日。此外，基金经理以部分费用换取新单位，导致已发行单位数量增加。
notable: 2026 年第三季度净利同比上升 55.8% 至 RM144.15 million，营收同比上升 55.7% 至 RM249.34 million。
宣布每单位 3.51 仙的收入分配（3.45 仙应税，0.06 仙非应税），除权日 11 月 13 日，派发日 11 月 30 日。
基金经理以 50% 现金、50% 新单位的形式收取 2026 年第三季度管理费，发行 3,119,499 个新单位，于 11 月 6 日上市。
risks: 基金经理费用以新单位支付，导致单位数量增加。
主要股东 EPF 及大股东在 10 月至 11 月期间有多项持股变动申报。
earnings: 2026 年第三季度营收为 RM249.34 million，同比上升 55.7%，环比上升 3.5%；净利为 RM144.15 million，同比上升 55.8%，环比上升 3.5%；净利率为 57.8%，与上季度持平。

recent_en: IGBREIT's 3Q2026 revenue and net profit both grew about 55% year-on-year, mainly driven by Southkey's contribution. The trust declared an income distribution of 3.51 sen per unit, with ex-date on 13 November. In addition, the Manager received new units for part of its fee, increasing the number of units in issue.
notable_en: 3Q2026 net profit rose 55.8% year-on-year to RM144.15 million, while revenue rose 55.7% year-on-year to RM249.34 million.
Declared an income distribution of 3.51 sen per unit (3.45 sen taxable and 0.06 sen non-taxable), with ex-date on 13 November and payment date on 30 November.
The Manager received its 3Q2026 management fee 50% in cash and 50% in new units, issuing 3,119,499 new units listed on 6 November.
risks_en: The Manager's fee was paid partly in new units, increasing the number of units and potentially slightly diluting existing unitholders.
Substantial shareholder EPF and major shareholders filed multiple changes in interest during October and November.
earnings_en: 3Q2026 revenue was RM249.34 million, up 55.7% year-on-year and 3.5% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was RM144.15 million, up 55.8% year-on-year and 3.5% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 57.8%, unchanged from the previous quarter.
